messages:
Priya (Acct Exec): quick one 9Cascade Health wants a 3-month Dedicated pilot. commit $18k/mo. asking to waive the $12k onboarding + 30% off months 1-3. need to close this week. @Elena (Finance) @Nina (Revenue Ops)
Ravi (Sales): +1. health ref -> high value. they want onboarding waived for data ingest runway. we should be able to expand.
Elena (Finance): need numbers and treatment: invoice discount vs credit memo? one-off or repeatable program?
Priya (Acct Exec): prefer discounted invoices (keeps ARR math clean). onboarding as one-time credit memo. quick calc: commit=$18,000/mo x3 = $54,000; 30% discount on pilot = $16,200; onboarding waived = $12,000; total concession = $28,200. post-pilot ARR if retained = $216,000/year.
Nina (Revenue Ops): we'll attach a pilot line-item (Cascade-PLT-001) and revenue tag for attribution. will gate by metered success metric.
Jules (Legal): will draft a short amendment: 3mo pilot, pricing schedule, auto-convert to standard T&Cs, onboarding waiver conditional on signed SOW by EOD Fri.
deal-desk-bot: automated reminder: attach draft amendment + SOW. requests without SOW are provisional.
Elena (Finance): conditional approval if (1) revenue tagging + pilot line-item exists, (2) amendment with auto-convert is added, (3) signed SOW by EOD Fri. prefer discount shown as invoice line-item, and onboarding as credit memo at start.
Ravi (Sales): SOW in progress, target EOD Fri. i'll drop link here when signed.
Priya (Acct Exec): will post SOW and amendment draft. can billing prep the workflow to apply $12k credit memo and monthly 30% discount when approved?
billing-team: noted 9we'll wait for formal approval and documents. prepare credit memo template and custom line-item flow.
Elena (Finance): ping me with the SOW link once uploaded. if all conditions met i'll sign off and instruct billing to apply the credit and discounts for months 1-3.
Priya (Acct Exec): thanks all 9following up later today. :pray:
